detector.hash_scope: installed native binary with bundled models
detector.confidence_semantics: relative model score; not calibrated correctness or residence probability

corpus.attribution: NLLB Team (2022), No Language Left Behind: Scaling Human-Centered Machine Translation
corpus.modifications: Only five language files selected; original sentence text unchanged. Evaluation sampling is deterministic.
corpus.domain: professionally translated general web article sentences; NOT restaurant reviews

evaluation_design.sampling: first unique sentences in official split file; fixed before scoring
evaluation_design.threshold_tuning: none; rules fixed before corpus evaluation
evaluation_design.training_corpus_overlap: not audited; independence from detector pretraining not claimed
